what: New REVIEW_CORE_STATUS aggregator-empty-merge is not mapped to terminal complete
scenario_or_breakage: After Item B, review-core emits aggregator-empty-merge with exit 0; review-and-fix falls through to *) and sets IRF_LAST_ROUND_STATUS=aggregator-empty-merge; review-implement-step5-loop.sh:200-203 treats unknown statuses as stall (round-failed-aggregator-empty-merge, exit 2). Benign attestation-only rounds that previously ended as ok+complete now abort /implement Step 5
suggested_fix: Add aggregator-empty-merge to the zero-findings|ok arm in review-and-fix.sh (status=complete) and to the converged-small-changes|…|complete arm in review-implement-step5-loop.sh, or keep emitting REVIEW_CORE_STATUS=ok on this path if consumer wiring is out of scope
